name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.3 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 5 visits over 44 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 44 hours starting 2026-06-02, at wavelengths from 1.66 to 4.92 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
